full_judgment:
Mr. Bhuyian, the learned Advocate, next submits that S.A. and R.S. records and the rent receipts are evidence of possession and that according to section 144A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (shortly the Act, 1950) the S.A. and R.S. records are to be presumed as correct until rebutted by better evidence. 

 According to section 144A of the Act, 1950 entries in the finally published S.A. record (Exhibit-2) and R.S. record are presumed to be correct until rebutted by reliable evidence. This view is supported by the observations made in the case of Dayal Chandra Mandol and others vs. Assistant Custodian of vested and Non resident Property and others (50 DLR (1996) page-186, para-20.
